notes: Primary contact: CTO (Jared K). Product lead (Maya R) driving evaluation for support agent feature.
Use-case: real-time billing agents that can: 1) lookup invoices, 2) initiate refunds/voids (Stripe/Zuora), 3) generate structured JSON to attach to tickets.
Latency SLO: target p50 < 150ms, p95 < 250ms, p99 < 300ms for single-turn streaming responses. Agent UX requires near-instant streaming tokens for appear-fast experience.
Volume: expected baseline 30 req/s, spiky to 120 req/s during business hours. Cost sensitivity noted — wants clear unit economics for hosted vs dedicated.
Security: must remain PCI-scoped; asking whether Hosted can be configured to remove card data footprint (tokenization + KMS). If not, Dedicated w/ VPC preferred.
Requested features: reliable tool calling (idempotency + retry semantics), structured output enforcement (JSON schema), streaming + function/tool calling support.
Quote from CTO: "If Hosted meets latency and PCI concerns we can start there for speed; otherwise we'll commit to Dedicated for isolation."
Asked about rollout patterns: canaries, A/B, automatic fallback to cheaper model variants on capacity issues — important for product roadmap.
POC metrics: end-to-end latency including tool call round-trip, JSON parse success rate, token cost per ticket, error/retry counts.
SE notes: will test streaming throughput on 'gpt-like' open models in Hosted; prep dedicated pricing scenarios with reserved + burst capacity.
